description: This file declares the WifiManagerWPS class, which provides an API for Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for initiating, canceling, saving SSID, clearing SSID, and retrieving paired SSID information.

classes.name: WifiManagerWPS
classes.description: A class managing Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) operations such as initiating pairing, canceling pairing, and retrieving paired SSID information.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts the WPS pairing process with provided parameters.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing WPS pairing process.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently paired network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks whether the device is currently paired.
